title: Multiplication machine states
statement: Define a finite state set with the following states: length testing and incrementing; pair testing and first-bit handling, each with a Boolean inner flag; pair second-bit and pair-reading states, each with Boolean inner and bit flags; pair advancement with a Boolean inner flag and a choice in a four-element set; copying with a stage in an eleven-element set and a Boolean bump flag; end-down states with Boolean inner and second flags; half-counting and count-down states with a Boolean second flag; canonical-form testing and clearing with a field in a three-element set, canonical down states with a field and Boolean second flag, and canonical reading with a field; and the parameter-free states column, clear-A, clear-P, outer, clear-B, clear-diagonal, inner, diagonal, first-bit, second-bit, add, next-P, result-test, result-read, carry-half, next-column, next-result-test, next-result, and final-position. Also include next-B with a Boolean second flag, next-diagonal, next-A with a Boolean second flag, parity with a Boolean bit, final-carry, and answer with a Boolean bit.
